text.en:
Establishment of a National Science High
School. - There is hereby established, under the supervision of
the Department of Education, a national science high school in
the City of Laag, Province of Ilocos Norte to be known as
Rodolfo CG. Fariñas, Jr. National Science High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education
shall immediately include in the Department's program the
operationalization of the Rodolfo CG. Fariñas, Jr. National
Science High School, the funding of which shall be included in
the annual General Appropriations Act.
SEc. 3. Implementation. - The Secretary of Education
shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the
provisions of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) davs after
its effectivity.

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a
newspaper of general circulation.
